prompts.prompt: In Google Workspace, what is the maximum number of domains, combining primary, alias, and secondary domains, that a single account can have? Answer concisely.
prompts.source: plugins/mail-collab/skills/google-workspace/SKILL.md - Account Model: Up to 600 domains (primary + alias + secondary).

prompts.prompt: When generating a new DKIM signing key for a domain in the Google Workspace Admin Console, what key length in bits is recommended? Answer concisely.
prompts.source: plugins/mail-collab/skills/google-workspace/SKILL.md - DKIM Configuration: Click Generate new record (2048-bit recommended).

prompts.prompt: When migrating from Google Workspace to Microsoft 365 with a tool like GWMME, does the migration bring over Google Chat history and Meet recordings along with email, calendar, and contacts? Answer in one sentence.
prompts.source: plugins/mail-collab/skills/google-workspace/SKILL.md - Migration > Google Workspace to M365: Migrates email/calendar/contacts. Does NOT migrate: Chat history, Meet recordings, Google Sites.
